finding: GRB 150902A is one of the best-documented bursts in the campaign so far: 8 circulars, a DEDICATED refereed paper claiming a significant sub-dominant blackbody (Band+BB, kT = 38.1 +/- 1.4 keV, dC-stat = 111.26 vs Band, phi = 0.065 +/- 0.007), a 21-sigma LLE detection with an 11 GeV photon at ~97 s, and three independent prompt-temporal frames (Li&Zhang 2021 HLE, Tak 2023 broad-pulse HLE, Li 2026 Ep-flux lag) that DISAGREE with each other about whether the decay is curvature-dominated. There is no redshift. The dominant frame-alignment hazards are (i) T7: Nawaz's Ep = 516.8 keV is the Band component of a Band+BB fit, not comparable to the 346 keV Band-only catalog Ep; (ii) T9/tail coverage: Konus-Wind sees a weak tail to ~100 s and the LAT to 408 s, while our window stops at +27.4 s and our POST background opens at +48 s.
